title: Collaboration history and partner choice
x: Prior collaboration with a prospective partner
y: Selection of that partner for a new project
unit: A firm choosing a collaboration partner
context: A firm must choose between two qualified partners for a new project. One designated partner has either no collaboration history or successful prior collaboration with the firm. The alternative is unfamiliar in both X conditions. Both partners remain feasible. Explore how external conditions change the relationship between collaboration history and partner selection.
